title: Complexity of Classical Acceleration for $\ell_1$-Regularized PageRank
summary: We study the degree-weighted work required to compute $\ell_1$-regularized PageRank using the standard accelerated proximal-gradient method (FISTA). For non-accelerated methods (ISTA), the best known worst-case work is $\widetilde{O}((αρ)^{-1})$, where $α$ is the teleportation parameter and $ρ$ is the $\ell_1$-regularization parameter. It is not known whether classical acceleration methods can improve $1/α$ to $1/\sqrtα$ while preserving the $1/ρ$ locality scaling, or whether they can be asymptotically worse.
